body: [{"streamId":"01a0d672-9342-71fa-8cef-3733dac1ec3a","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskAdded","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a0d672-9342-71fa-8cef-3733dac1ec3a\u0022,\u0022ProjectId\u0022:\u002201a0a27f-abdf-7731-84aa-d604e9bc53ca\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:\u0022odo walk on cars.com spends its per-pair cap only on used cars: new-car cards mixed into the used results are skipped at link collection, and any new-car detail page that still gets through is dropped as \\u0027new-car listing\\u0027 rather than \\u0027missing fields\\u0027\u0022,\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:[\u0022The cars.com link collector skips a search card whose title begins with \\u0027New \\u0027 (case-insensitive, for example \\u0027New 2027 Toyota Corolla Hybrid LE\\u0027), so those links never enter the candidate pool and never count against the per-pair cap; proven by a test over a fixture cut from the recorded search page walks/cars.com/20260925-021026/corolla-hybrid/search.txt (copied into the test project) that yields the used cards\\u0027 links and none of the eleven new-car cards\\u0027 links\u0022,\u0022A detail page that reads as a new-car page (title \\u0027New \\u003Cyear\\u003E \\u2026\\u0027, or an MSRP line with no Mileage line) produces a new DetailPageOutcome (for example NewCar) whose WalkOutcomeWording.DroppedReason is \\u0027new-car listing\\u0027, and the per-page detail line and the pair and run summaries use that wording; proven by a test over a fixture cut from the recorded detail-12.txt in the same directory, plus WalkPairSummaryLine tests covering the new reason alongside the existing ones\u0022,\u0022A used-car detail page that merely lacks year, price, or mileage still drops as \\u0027missing fields\\u0027; existing walk, summary, and coverage tests pass unchanged apart from the new outcome\u0022,\u0022The README\\u0027s walk section says new-car cards on cars.com are skipped; dotnet build and dotnet test succeed with zero warnings; commits are small with conventional messages, no em dashes, no AI attribution\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Bugfix\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022Reported by run session odonomics-40 on 2026-09-24 22:10 EDT during walk run 4 on main f88fb55 (also appended to notes/run-session-2026-09-22.md under \\u0027Gaps found\\u0027). cars.com returned 34 detail links for Toyota Corolla Hybrid with stock_type=used; details 12 through 22, eleven in a row, were new 2026 and 2027 Corolla Hybrids (VINs JTDBCMFE0V3171539, JTDBCMFE4V3170071, JTDBCMFEXT3155359 and eight more) and every one dropped as \\u0027missing fields (year/price/mileage)\\u0027, spending a third of the cap of 30 on cars the scenario can never rank. The recorded evidence is under the Odonomics data directory (~/Library/Application Support/Odonomics/walks/cars.com/20260925-021026/corolla-hybrid/): search.txt shows a block of compact \\u0027New 2027 Toyota Corolla Hybrid LE\\u0027 cards with no dealer name between the used listings (2 \\u0027New 2026 \\u2026 LE\\u0027, 1 \\u0027New 2026 \\u2026 SE\\u0027, 8 \\u0027New 2027 \\u2026 LE\\u0027); detail-12.txt is a new-car page with \\u0027Shop other new 2027 Toyota Corolla Hybrids\\u0027, MSRP, and \\u0027Vehicle price breakdown\\u0027, and no Mileage line. Code: link collection for cars.com is the /vehicledetail/ href regex in src/Odonomics/Walk/WalkSites.cs (CarsCom, CanonicalDetailUrl); the detail outcomes and their wording are DetailPageOutcome and WalkOutcomeWording in src/Odonomics/Walk/WalkDetailWalk.cs; summaries in WalkPairSummaryLine.cs; tests in tests/Odonomics.Tests. Prefer skipping at collection time, since the over-fetch multiplier (DetailLinkOverfetchMultiplier) already assumes some candidates are dropped; the detail-page classification is the backstop. Do not touch the run skill file in the project home; the orchestrator updates
